import React from 'react'; const Resume = () => { const handleDownload = () => { // Create a link element and trigger download const link = document.createElement('a'); link.href = '/resume.pdf'; // You'll need to add your resume PDF to the public folder link.download = 'Rohith_R_Resume.pdf'; document.body.appendChild(link); link.click(); document.body.removeChild(link); }; const resumeData = { personalInfo: { name: 'Rohith R', title: 'AI & Data Science Student | LLM Agent Developer', email: 'rohith3824r1@gmail.com', location: 'Coimbatore, India', github: 'https://github.com/Cluster3824', linkedin: 'https://www.linkedin.com/in/rohith-r-795383297/' }, summary: 'Passionate third-year B.Tech student specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science with hands-on experience in LLM agent development, machine learning, and full-stack web development. Proven track record in building innovative AI solutions and contributing to open-source projects.', education: { degree: 'B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science', institution: 'Engineering College, Coimbatore', period: '2022 - 2026', status: 'Third Year Student' }, skills: { programming: ['Python', 'C++', 'C', 'Java', 'JavaScript'], web: ['React.js', 'Node.js', 'HTML5', 'CSS3', 'RESTful APIs'], aiml: ['PyTorch', 'TensorFlow', 'Machine Learning', 'Neural Networks'], llm: ['Hugging Face', 'LangChain', 'LangGraph', 'Ollama', 'Google ADK'], tools: ['Linux', 'Git', 'MySQL', 'Shell Scripting'] }, projects: [ { name: 'HSN Code LLM Agent', tech: 'Google ADK, Ollama, LiteLLM, Python', description: 'AI-powered HSN Code validation and suggestion system with 95% accuracy' }, { name: 'Hybrid Research Agent', tech: 'LangChain, Python, APIs', description: 'Real-time information retrieval chatbot from multiple sources' }, { name: 'Snake Game', tech: 'C++, SFML', description: 'Classic game with smooth gameplay and collision detection' }, { name: 'PDF & CSV Reader', tech: 'Python, Pandas', description: 'Data analysis tool with automated insights generation' } ], experience: [ { title: 'LLM Agent Developer', company: 'Personal Projects', period: '2024 - Present', achievements: [ 'Developed multiple LLM agents using cutting-edge technologies', 'Implemented AI workflows with LangGraph and LangChain', 'Built real-time data processing systems' ] }, { title: 'Open Source Contributor', company: 'GitHub Community', period: '2023 - Present', achievements: [ 'Contributed to machine learning libraries', 'Maintained 4+ major repositories', 'Collaborated with global developer community' ] } ] }; return (
